Runs the four .tine v2 checks in order (format, step_hashes, chain, completeness); a certified verdict requires all four, any failure is rejected fail closed with reasons[] (step_hash_mismatch@i, duplicate_step_hash@i, chain_link_mismatch@i, chain_root_link_invalid@0, chain_sequence_mismatch, chain_root_hash_mismatch, parent_ref_malformed, parent_step_index_invalid, parent_step_index_out_of_range, dangling_step_ref@i, step_index_mismatch@i, run_id_invalid, artifact_not_json, artifact_not_object, ...). Returns {certification_id:'crt_<16hex>', result:'certified'|'rejected', reason, reasons[], checks:[{name:'format'|'step_hashes'|'chain'|'completeness', pass, detail}], artifact_sha256 (canonical content digest), body_sha256 (exact submitted bytes), steps_verified, issued_at, key_id, sig, statement, cached:false, disclaimer}. Re-certifying the identical artifact inside DDG_CERTIFY_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS (default 24h) returns the stored certification with cached:true and re-signs nothing. Body {tine_hash} (64 hex) reads back a stored certification by digest, 404 when the digest was never certified. Result is a signed fact about provenance, not a judgement about the work.
